title: AltaMed Health Services notifies of unauthorized access to an employee email account
date_note: Dated by AltaMed's filing with the California Attorney General, whose breach register lists Reported Date 11/08/2026 and Date of Breach 09/09/2026. AltaMed's website notice is undated (file name carries 11.12.2026). Previously dated 18 November from a law-firm page.
place: California, United States (location of the incident not stated)
geo_basis: state only, as the organisation's location is not stated in the pages read
summary: AltaMed Health Services Corporation says that on September 9, 2026 it was targeted by a social engineering campaign that resulted in unauthorized access to one employee email account. It says some patient information may have been accessed, which could have included name, dates of birth, Social Security number, diagnosis, and billing information. AltaMed filed a notice with the California Attorney General; the number of people affected is not stated in the pages read.
plain: A health provider says a social engineering campaign gave someone access to one employee's email account, which may have exposed some patients' personal and billing details.
exec: Healthcare provider reports patient data may have been accessed through one email account; identity-theft risk for patients.
action: If you are an AltaMed patient, review healthcare statements and contact the provider or insurer about charges for services not received; AltaMed lists a call center at 888-269-3345 (Mon-Fri, 9am-9pm Pacific).
impact: Number of people affected not stated in the pages read.
